sector.title: Sector screen
sector.cohort_caption: {n} companies — the {etf} basket, widened with listed names outside the US.
sector.empty_body: Every night the app builds a comparable cohort for each of the eleven sectors and ranks it on valuation and quality. Nothing has been scanned yet — refresh a sector to build one now.
sector.refreshing: Scanning {sector} — this asks Yahoo for every company in the cohort.
sector.podium_help: Ranked by a percentile score across 18 valuation and quality metrics, relative to this cohort of {cohort}. It says "the best three of these", not "the best three anywhere", and it measures neither momentum nor what analysts expect.
sector.no_podium: Too few companies here report enough metrics to rank a podium.
sector.pass_caption: {n} of {total} companies pass — re-sort with **Rank by**.
sector.verdict_computed: Written without the assistant — the figures, stated.
sector.verdict_signin: Sign in to have the assistant read this podium against what you hold.
sector.source_down: Yahoo would not answer for {sector}. Showing the last scan.
sector.fb_empty: Not enough comparable data in {sector} to rank a podium.
